author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹುಟ್ಟೆಂದು ಸಾರ್ಥಕವು ಪರಹಿತವ ಸಾಧಿಸಿರೆ
ಗುಟ್ಟದುವೆ ಅರಿತುನಡೆ ಶ್ರೇಯವದರಿಂದ
ದಟ್ಟುಸುಕು ಭೂಮಿಯಲುದಕ ತೃಷೆ ಕಳೆವಂತೆ
ಹುಟ್ಟ ಮಾದರಿಮಾಡು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Birth is fulfilled when you achieve good for others;
know this secret and walk on; your welfare comes from it;
as water in dense sandy soil quenches thirst,
make your birth an example, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A life is fulfilled by serving others. Like water hidden in dry sand that quenches a traveller’s thirst, let your life be an example of quiet usefulness.
